params.prompt: Game concept art, key visual for an indie narrative simulation game set in a fictional small riverside town around 1935. Wide establishing shot at dusk: a muddy main street with a general store, a church steeple, a wooden covered bridge, a timber sawmill belching smoke by the river, and in the foreground a narrow two-storey brick newspaper office with one warm lit window and a hand-painted sign. A few tiny townsfolk silhouettes walking home. Gouache painted look with a deliberately limited 16-colour muted palette (ochre, slate blue, brick red, bottle green, cream), visible paper grain, soft dithering like upscaled pixel art, melancholic and quiet atmosphere. No legible text anywhere, no modern objects, no cars newer than 1930s.
params.name: town
